_meta.search_methods: Tried multiple public indexed searches, slow/high-confidence search, direct URL open and index navigation. No additional individual place data retrieved. Public cache does not establish current content or member activity.
major_gaps: Individual spot detail pages inaccessible: no reliable exact GPS, last visit date, complete Where/Best times/Crowd/Watch out fields.
Only two cached all-category index pages accessible, and they carry inconsistent global totals; page 3+ unknown.
Outdoor and Parking filters blocked; source contents mix swinger, heterosexual, naturist and gay categories.
No indexed eligible records in the 49 user-priority cities across the 20 preserved source records; no conclusion about absence of cruising in those cities.
Entries refer to older/undated personal experiences. Gay-male relevance and legal public access not established on many locations.
_meta.decision: Do not spend additional research time trying to circumvent blocked pages. Revisit only for a specific unsolved listing or if normal access later improves; prioritise Scrape 8 (CruisingGays) for geographical discoveries.
_meta.safety: No personal check-ins, real-time attendance or member data reviewed. All findings are old public place descriptions, not individually confirmed. Do not publish unsafe or restricted routes.
